title: The review tab's snapshot
description: What `ingestion tui --view review --json` prints: each item that waits on a person, ordered by the board's default grouping and, within each group, by the sort in force, the key that picks each of review's choices, the digit that the note's menu places by each placing choice with, and how each read stands. A change to its shape bumps schema_version.

taken_at.description: When the snapshot was taken, in UTC.

grouping.description: The board's default grouping, which orders the items. A display the person left grouped otherwise does not change it.

sort.description: The sort in force, which orders the items within each group. An item with no value for the sort follows every item with one.

choices.description: The key that picks each of review's choices, and where the choice sends an item under the set in force, as review-list.schema.json's choices. Null where the queue came without its choices or was not read.

note_choices.description: What each digit of the note's menu places with: each choice that places an item, in the order of choices, then each of the review list's destinations that none of them reaches, by name, up to nine in all. Null where the queue came without its choices or was not read.

choice.description: The placing choice, or null where the digit places on a destination.

destination.description: The destination that the digit places on by name, or null where it places by a choice.

group.description: The key of the group the item draws under, such as reason/quality-review.

source.description: What the row's first column names: the channel that published the item, such as a video's channel or r/<subreddit>, or else its connectors.

rank.description: The item's place under the sort in force among every item shown, from 1.

sources.description: Each read the tab makes, as its last read left it.

unread_sources.description: The reads with no good answer yet, so an empty items list is unknown rather than empty.
